blocks.originalExcerpt: The central insight that makes loop engineering relevant to this book is that a well-engineered agent loop is structurally identical to an RL optimization process operating at inference time—without gradient updates to the model weights:

blocks.expression: st = context(st−1 , at−1 , ot−1 ) (state = accumulated context) at = πθ (st ) (action = model generation) ot = env(at ) (observation = tool/environment feedback) rt = verify(st , at , ot ) (reward = verification signal) (19.1) The loop continues until rt exceeds a success threshold or a termination condition triggers. The “policy” πθ is not updated via gradients; instead, the state is updated—observations, error messages, and reflections are appended to the context, conditioning the same frozen model to produce better actions on subsequent iterations. This is precisely the mechanism behind Reflexion [326]: the model improves across iterations not by learning new weights but by reading its own failure history. summary: 从业人员与LLM基体相互作用的演变，遵循了非常一致的轨迹。2022–2024年，主要技能是即时工程:精心设计正确的词句，从单一的模型调用中引出所期望的响应。到2025年，重点转移到了背景工程——对模型在推断时看到的全套符号进行校准，包括检索的文件、工具产出和对话历史[10]。在前一章中，我们谈到了“牵引工程”:设计一个Agent周围的运行时环境——工具、沙盒、记忆和护栏。循环工程[279]是这个进化的下一层:设计迭代控制结构，将一个Agent自动地向一个目标推进，而不需要一个人类在每个转弯时键入下一个指令。从快速到循环:工程进度
